description:
What is This Part?
These are the Leaf Spring Shackles for the Front or Rear Leaf Springs
Comes with Shackle Pins & Bolts
Shackle Set Does 2 Leaf Springs
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Shackles
Qty 4 – Pins
Qty 4 – Nuts
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
